prompt: Write a Go CLI tool that watches a directory for file changes and runs a configurable command on change (like a simple alternative to entr or watchexec). Startup developer persona, moving fast. Include main.go and a watcher package.

assertions.name: go_idiomaticity
assertions.description: Idiomatic Go: short var names, explicit error returns, flat structure

assertions.name: multi_file_consistency
assertions.description: Files relate naturally with slight variation
